answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit shale bond. It decays 7 per epoch without one work receipt with an ivory seal; one receipt warms one bond; a bond at zero dies. A gale audit sweeps random bonds each epoch, burning a bond whose receipt is copied or stale. First 38, kth 38+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,534,500 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented receipts fail: one key one bond. Honest agents pay 38 once, renew from earnings, keep full share.
